citation.title: Serum Galanin Levels in Young Healthy Lean and Obese Non-Diabetic Men during an Oral Glucose Tolerance Test

population.description: Two groups of 30 young men in Colombia: healthy lean (BMI 22.18 ± 1.75 kg/m2, Table 1) and obese non-diabetic (BMI 37.83 ± 4.92, Table 1); diabetes, chronic disease, bariatric surgery and recent levothyroxine, metformin or steroids excluded; no glucose-tolerance screening is reported. Each arm carries its own group's status, age and BMI (override). Age mean ± SD is from the Methods (lean 24.68 ± 3.56, obese 24.12 ± 3.96 y; Table 1 prints medians 23 and 22). The Methods print a different BMI (lean 22.13 ± 1.85, obese 38.54 ± 4.57); Table 1's is used.

protocols.name: ogtt_lean
protocols.description: 75 g glucose in 300 mL given at 07:00 after an overnight fast to the healthy lean men (n = 30), blood at 0, 30, 60 and 120 min (Methods); minute 0 is the load, so the arm runs to minute 120 (duration 121). Overnight fast length is not printed: prefast_hours 10 is the guide's default. Age and BMI as in the fasted arm of the same group.

protocols.name: ogtt_obese
protocols.description: 75 g glucose in 300 mL given at 07:00 after an overnight fast to the obese non-diabetic men (n = 30), blood at 0, 30, 60 and 120 min (Methods); minute 0 is the load, so the arm runs to minute 120 (duration 121). Overnight fast length is not printed: prefast_hours 10 is the guide's default. Age and BMI as in the fasted arm of the same group.

protocols.name: fasted_lean
protocols.description: Healthy lean men (n = 30), the fasting sample before the 07:00 load: a 30-minute fasted run-in standing for the single fasting draw (the fasting sample was drawn at minute 0 of the OGTT, 07:00; Methods), no meal, read at minute 29-30. start_hour = 7.0 - 0.5 = 6.5; prefast_hours = 10 - 0.5 = 9.5 (the overnight fast's length is not printed, 10 h is the guide's default). The arithmetic and the run-in length are mine. The blood pressure of Table 1 has no stated time of day or fasting state; it is entered on this same fasted morning, as the guide directs.

protocols.name: fasted_obese
protocols.description: Obese non-diabetic men (n = 30), the fasting sample before the 07:00 load: a 30-minute fasted run-in standing for the single fasting draw (the fasting sample was drawn at minute 0 of the OGTT, 07:00; Methods), no meal, read at minute 29-30. start_hour = 7.0 - 0.5 = 6.5; prefast_hours = 10 - 0.5 = 9.5 (the overnight fast's length is not printed, 10 h is the guide's default). The arithmetic and the run-in length are mine. The blood pressure of Table 1 has no stated time of day or fasting state; it is entered on this same fasted morning, as the guide directs.
